newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vebacom seeks half-share in E-Plus.
newsitem.headline: Vebacom seeks half-share in E-Plus.

text.p: Vebacom GmbH, a unit of utility Veba AG and Cable & Wireless Plc, wants to raise its stake in the E-Plus mobile phone network to up to 50 percent, a top executive said on Monday.
Veba currently owns 37.5 percent of E-Plus, Germany's third mobile phone system, along with Thyssen AG, Bellsouth and Vodafone.
"We are seeking as much as half of the shares in E-Plus," Vebacom managing director Wolfgang Steiert said after a news conference in Munich.
Under the terms of a cooperation deal announced with Cable & Wireless and utility RWE AG, Vebacom will contribute its equity in E-Plus to a joint venture between the three companies.
Steiert also said that he expected Vebacom to break even at around the turn of the century, and Vebacom investments with its two partners should reach nine billion marks by 2005.
He added that plans for cooperation in the digital pay television area with retail group Metro AG were "not completely off the agenda".
